dm_hypogamy.definition: Pairing with a person who has less of a valued resource, such as income, education or position, than the chooser.
dm_hypogamy.example: When one partner earns more, the pairing is hypogamy from one side and hypergamy from the other.

jump_start.definition: Starting a car with a flat battery by connecting it to the battery of another car with cables.
jump_start.example: Could you send someone to jump start the car? The battery is flat.

mathlit_definition.definition: A statement that fixes the exact meaning of a word, so that everybody uses it the same way.
mathlit_definition.example: The definition of a tolerance is written at the top of the drawing, and every measurement follows it.
